app.title: PcapAnalyzer – self-hosted pcap analyzer with 27 problem detectors
app.description: Self‑hosted Python application that parses pcap files and runs 27 built‑in detectors to flag network anomalies and security issues.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and install dependencies via pip install -r requirements.txt.
Run the CLI analyzer on a provided sample pcap and verify that the output contains at least one detection from the known set.
Spin up the web UI container, send a sample pcap via the UI, and confirm the dashboard displays detected events.
Benchmark analysis time on a 50MB pcap against a baseline Zeek run and verify that PcapAnalyzer completes within 2× the Zeek duration.
